evidence.title: LWS/MWS: review-supported site 180
evidence.notes: The review figure caption broadly says bovine numbering, but these five LWS positions use human red/green opsin numbering. Kawamura et al. explicitly distinguish human positions 180/197/277/285/308 from RH1-aligned 164/181/261/269/292. Anchored to human LWS P04000; frozen alignment independently reproduces these correspondences. Site-level claim only; no universal substitution or effect magnitude inferred.
